title: "Give Up" tapes — Amsterdam talks recorded by Henk Schonewille
duration: c. 4.5 h released; c. 24 h recorded
description: Three weeks of Amsterdam talks in September 1982; Schonewille's recorder captured almost all of them (c. 24 hours) with U.G.'s permission. Released as the 3-cassette 'Give Up' series (c. 4.5 h, 1995 foreword), transcribed by Ellen Chrystal into The Courage to Stand Alone. Online audio uploaded by petermaverick.

title: The Courage to Stand Alone — Amsterdam 1982 recordings (archive.org)
description: Internet Archive item for the Amsterdam September 1982 talks recorded by Henk Schonewille and transcribed by Ellen Chrystal; Public Domain Mark 1.0.

title: Blog post: Talks — Give Up & Terry Newland (remembering-ug)
description: Remembering UG blog post pairing the Give Up tapes with Terry Newland material.

title: Mind Is a Myth — tape provenance (Terry Newland, mid-1980s)
description: Mind Is a Myth (Dinesh Publications 1988; PhilPapers dates 1987) edited by Terry Newland, compiled from tape-recorded conversations in Bangalore and elsewhere in the mid-1980s; a blog says Newland brought mimeographed copies. Current holder of the Newland tapes not found.

title: Mind is a Myth — computer-voice audio reading
description: Synthetic-voice reading of the book Mind is a Myth on the Internet Archive.

title: The Mystique of Enlightenment — tape provenance (Rodney Arms, 1973–1980)
description: The Mystique of Enlightenment (ed. Rodney Arms) was compiled from tapes of conversations recorded in Gstaad and Bangalore 1973–1980; no source found on who recorded them or where the tapes are.

title: Thought Is Your Enemy / No Way Out — tape provenance (Moorty & Noronha, 1985–1990)
description: Thought Is Your Enemy (Sowmya Publishers, Bangalore, 1990) and No Way Out compiled from discussions with inquirers in India, Switzerland, Australia, Netherlands and UK between 1985 and 1990. A memoir notes Narayana Moorty lent audio tapes to a visitor, so Moorty held a personal tape collection; Noronha's archive not located.

title: Stopped in Our Tracks — Narayana Moorty's own tapes (memoir with transcripts)
description: Stopped in Our Tracks, memoir with transcripts drawn from Moorty's own tapes; PDF on the Internet Archive.

title: Conversation With U.G., Gstaad, Switzerland (9 September 1967)
description: Earliest known recording online, a Gstaad conversation of 9 September 1967, two months after the 'calamity'. Part of the 1967–71 Gstaad tapes that became The Biology of Enlightenment; early Swiss friends presumed to have recorded.

title: Internet Archive collection: U.G. Krishnamurti conversations and interviews – audio
format: archive.org collection (80 items; VBR MP3 / OGG / RealAudio / torrent)
description: Collection of 80 audio items created by Jeff Kaplan, most added 2012; several credit source ugkrishnamurti.org. Index numbers in descriptions correspond to the WELL 'Essential UG' index. Collection note: UG wrote no books; others recorded his informal discussions.

title: Conversation between U.G. & David Bohm (17 August 1968)
description: Recorded conversation between U.G. and physicist David Bohm, 17 August 1968; also indexed on the David Bohm Society audio page. An excerpt is also downloadable via Sat Sangha Salon.

title: All India Radio interview — 'Ending of knowledge is death' (12 December 1979)
description: All India Radio interview; ugkrishnamurti.in's Old Audios page titles the AIR recording 'Ending of knowledge is death – December 12, 1979'. Added to archive.org 29 August 2012.

title: Conversation with Barbara Schuler, KAZU Radio (May 1989)
format: radio broadcast (OGG / RealAudio / VBR MP3 / torrent)
description: KAZU public radio (Monterey Bay) conversation with Barbara Schuler, May 1989. A YouTube copy also exists.

title: New Dimensions Radio programme (14 November 1989)
description: New Dimensions Radio programme with Michael and Justine Toms, 14 November 1989. Also on SoundCloud. New Dimensions Media records (release forms/transcripts incl. a 1989 'Krishnamurti' entry) are at the Online Archive of California; the Toms archive went to Stanford in 2007.

title: New Dimensions Media records — finding aid (Online Archive of California)
description: New Dimensions Media records including release forms and transcripts with a 1989 'Krishnamurti' entry; Michael Toms archive acquired by Stanford in 2007. Documentation of the 14 Nov 1989 broadcast.

title: 'Swan Song' video (~3 min) on Remembering UG
